module Ceradoc
  module Output
    module Adoc
      module Serializers
        module Block
          class CustomBlockSerializer < Core
            def serialize_to_adoc
              parts = []
              parts << @model.gen_delimiter << "\n"
              parts << @model.gen_title
              parts << @model.gen_attributes
              parts << @model.gen_lines
              parts << @model.gen_delimiter << "\n"
              parts.join
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

module CeradocPlugin
  class MyCustomBlock < Ceradoc::Model::Block::Core
    attribute :my_attr, :string
  end
  class MyCustomBlockSerializer
    def initialize(model)
      @model = model
    end
    def serialize_to_adoc
      "!!!\n#{@model.my_attr}\n!!!\n"
    end
  end
end
# Register plugin
Ceradoc::Plugin.register do |plugin|
  plugin.block :my_custom_block,
              class: CeradocPlugin::MyCustomBlock,
              serializer: CeradocPlugin::MyCustomBlockSerializer
end

Ceradoc.config.before_parse do |input, options|
  # Transform input before parsing
  input.gsub(/custom/, "replaced")
end

Ceradoc.config.after_parse do |document, options|
  # Transform document after parsing
  document.header.title = document.header.title.upcase
end

Ceradoc.config.before_serialize do |model, options|
  # Transform model before serialization
end

Ceradoc.config.after_serialize do |output, options|
  # Transform output after serialization
  output.gsub(/<[^>]+>/, "") # Remove HTML tags
end

Extension Best Practices

# 1. Namespace Your Extensions

children.content:
# Good
module MyProject
  module CeradocExtensions
    class CustomBlock < Ceradoc::Model::Block::Core
    end
  end
end
# Avoid
class CustomBlock < Ceradoc::Model::Block::Core
end

# Good: Inherit from appropriate base
class MyBlock < Ceradoc::Model::Block::Core
end
class MyInline < Ceradoc::Model::Inline::Base
end
# Avoid: Don't inherit from unrelated classes
class MyBlock < Ceradoc::Model::Inline::Base  # Wrong!

class MySerializer
  def serialize_to_adoc
    begin
      generate_output
    rescue StandardError => e
      raise Ceradoc::SerializationError, "Failed to serialize: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end

require 'ceradoc'
require 'my_extensions'
RSpec.describe MyCustomBlock do
  it "serializes correctly" do
    block = MyCustomBlock.new
    block.my_attr = "test"
    expect(block.to_adoc).to include("test")
  end
end
